id: 01_Proper Dress and PPE Lab Safety Video Part 1
title: 进实验室，先穿对、戴好（国内版）
source_doc: course/Chemical Spillage & Response/01_Proper Dress and PPE Lab Safety Video Part 1.md
author_source: project/Chemical Spillage & Response/01_Proper Dress and PPE Lab Safety Video Part 1（国内版）/src.py

points.K8: 扣好实验服，袖口进手套
points.S2: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜
points.S4: 手套先检查，脱下有讲究

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着扣好的实验服、戴护目镜，站在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a buttoned lab coat and safety goggles, standing at a lab door and waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲进实验室怎么穿、怎么防护。

shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套、包脚鞋四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a lab coat, safety goggles, a pair of gloves and a closed-toe shoe. No people.
shots.narration: 穿对衣服，戴好防护，再动手。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿短裤、凉鞋，背着背包，大步走向实验室门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in shorts and sandals, carrying a backpack, walks quickly toward a lab door.
shots.narration: 夏天，阿杰穿着短裤凉鞋就要进实验室。

shots.scene: 小研在门口伸手拦住他，指了指他的脚
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him at the door with a raised hand and points at his feet.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：这样进去可不行。

shots.scene: 实验室房间图标上方亮起黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab room icon with a yellow warning triangle above it. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室本身就有危险。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰并肩站在实验台前，各自戴好护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student stand side by side at a lab bench, both wearing safety goggles.
shots.narration: 风险有多大，取决于你和身边的人。

shots.scene: 王老师把一本空白的安全守则递给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank safety rule booklet to the young male student.
shots.narration: 了解规则、遵守规则，是每个人的责任。

shots.scene: 放大镜图标扫过实验台上的几个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon moves over a lab bench with small hazard pictograms on it. No people.
shots.narration: 还要学会发现身边的安全隐患。

shots.scene: 一滴液体溅向裸露手臂，皮肤图标出现红色警示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a liquid drop splashing onto a bare forearm, with a red warning mark on the skin. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品碰到皮肤，就可能造成伤害。

shots.scene: 小研换上长袖长裤，衣物遮住全身
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in long sleeves and long pants that cover her whole body.
shots.narration: 最好的办法，是让衣物遮住全身。

shots.scene: 短裤和凉鞋图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of shorts and open sandals crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 短裤和凉鞋，会让皮肤露在外面。

shots.scene: 长裤和包住脚趾、脚背的鞋子图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of long pants and closed-toe shoes covering the whole foot, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 要穿长裤和不露脚趾的鞋。

shots.scene: 小研把戒指和手链放进储物盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes off a ring and a bracelet and puts them into a small storage box.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先摘下首饰。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎成马尾并盘起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair into a ponytail and pins it up.
shots.narration: 长头发要扎起来。

shots.scene: 阿杰把背包和外套放进门外的储物柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his backpack and jacket into a locker outside the lab door.
shots.narration: 背包、外套这些私人物品，留在门外。

shots.scene: 沾上污渍的背包图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a backpack with a chemical stain on it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只带需要的东西进去，免得被污染。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现实验服、眼镜、手套三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three floating icons: a lab coat, safety glasses and gloves.
shots.narration: 一般实验，三件防护必不可少。

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴眼镜和手套走到实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, safety glasses and gloves, walks up to a lab bench.
shots.narration: 实验服、眼镜或护目镜、手套。

shots.section_title: 扣好实验服，袖口进手套
shots.scene: 小研把实验服纽扣一颗颗扣好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student buttons her lab coat all the way up.
shots.narration: 实验服要把扣子全部扣好。
overlay: 扣好实验服，袖口进手套

shots.section_title: 扣好实验服，袖口进手套
shots.scene: 手套口拉过实验服袖口的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a glove cuff pulled over the sleeve of a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 袖口尽量塞进手套里。

shots.scene: 老周在实验服外系上化学防护围裙
shots.prompt_en: The older man ties a chemical-resistant apron over his lab coat.
shots.narration: 有喷溅，或用挥发、活泼溶液，加穿围裙。

shots.scene: 安全眼镜挡住飞来的碎屑图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of safety glasses blocking small flying fragments. No people.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜，能挡住飞来的碎屑。

shots.scene: 液体从侧面绕过安全眼镜溅向眼睛，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid splashing around the side of safety glasses toward an eye, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但挡不住从侧面溅来的液体。

shots.scene: 小研戴上四周贴合面部的护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on sealed chemical splash goggles that fit snugly around her eyes.
shots.narration: 有喷溅危险，要戴耐化学品的护目镜。

shots.scene: 小研站在一排空白手套盒前挑选
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student chooses from a row of blank glove boxes on a wall rack.
shots.narration: 手套要一直戴着，还要选对类型。

shots.scene: 手套图标旁对照一张空白的耐受性表格
shots.prompt_en: A glove icon next to a blank chemical resistance chart with check marks and crosses. No people.
shots.narration: 选能耐受所用化学品的手套。

shots.scene: 液滴慢慢渗进手套的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram of a glove with a chemical drop slowly seeping through over a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品会随时间慢慢渗过手套。

shots.scene: 小研摘下手套，在水槽边换新手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves at a lab sink and takes a fresh pair from a blank box.
shots.narration: 沾上化学品，就及时换手套。

shots.scene: 流水下用洗手液洗手
shots.prompt_en: Hands are washed with soap under running water at a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 勤换手套，也要勤洗手。

shots.scene: 小研戴厚隔热手套打开高压灭菌器的盖子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing thick heat-resistant gloves, opens the lid of a benchtop autoclave.
shots.narration: 拿高温的东西，戴隔热手套。

shots.scene: 戴长款低温手套的手从超低温冰箱里取出盒子
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a long insulated cryogenic glove takes a box out of a frosty ultra-low freezer. No people.
shots.narration: 取干冰、超低温样品，戴低温手套。

shots.scene: 防刺穿手套和锐器盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cut-resistant glove next to a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 处理锐器，戴防刺穿手套。

shots.scene: 通风柜里的烧杯飘出蒸汽图标
shots.prompt_en: A beaker giving off wavy vapor lines with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有些化学品会放出危险的蒸气。

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰演示半面罩呼吸器的佩戴
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows the young male student how to put on a half-face respirator with filter cartridges.
shots.narration: 呼吸器能防护，但必须先培训再使用。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周询问，老周点头指向空白培训通知
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man, who nods and points at a blank training notice.
shots.narration: 需要时，向实验室负责人或老师申请培训。

shots.scene: 小研在门边脱下实验服挂好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes off her lab coat and hangs it on a hook by the lab door.
shots.narration: 离开实验室前，脱下防护用品。

shots.scene: 小研洗手后走出实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands at the sink, then walks out of the lab into a hallway.
shots.narration: 洗干净手，再进入公共区域。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手去按电灯开关、拧门把手、拿手机，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons of a gloved hand touching a light switch, a door handle and a mobile phone, all crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，别碰开关、门把手和手机。

shots.scene: 门把手上留下扩散的污点图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a door handle with stains spreading out to other objects around it. No people.
shots.narration: 否则会把污染带给别人。

shots.scene: 小研翻看一份空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet with pictogram boxes at her desk.
shots.narration: 做实验前，先查化学品的安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白风险评估表勾选防护
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student tick items on a blank risk assessment form with PPE icons.
shots.narration: 评估风险，再定穿戴哪些防护。

shots.section_title: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜
shots.scene: 隐形眼镜图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a contact lens crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学类实验室，原则上不戴隐形眼镜。
overlay: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜

shots.section_title: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜
shots.scene: 小研戴框架眼镜，外面再罩上护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears prescription glasses with large safety goggles fitted over them.
shots.narration: 近视就戴框架眼镜，外面罩护目镜。

shots.scene: 老周在护目镜外戴上透明面屏
shots.prompt_en: The older man puts a clear face shield on over his safety goggles.
shots.narration: 腐蚀性强、可能剧烈反应时，

shots.scene: 面屏挡住飞溅液滴的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a face shield blocking splashing drops in front of a face. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜外再加面屏，保护整张脸。

shots.section_title: 手套先检查，脱下有讲究
shots.scene: 小研戴手套前对着光检查手套有没有破洞
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a glove to the light and checks it for holes before putting it on.
shots.narration: 戴手套前，先检查有没有破损。
overlay: 手套先检查，脱下有讲究

shots.section_title: 手套先检查，脱下有讲究
shots.scene: 小研捏住手套外侧翻脱，外面朝里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student peels off one glove by pinching the outside, turning it inside out without touching her skin.
shots.narration: 脱手套时外面朝里，别让外面碰到皮肤。

shots.section_title: 手套先检查，脱下有讲究
shots.scene: 脱下的手套丢进实验室废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Used gloves drop into a lab waste bin with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的手套，按规定丢弃。

shots.scene: 棉质实验服打勾，易熔化纤衣物被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cotton lab coat icon with a green check next to a melting synthetic fabric icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服宜选棉质或阻燃材质。

shots.scene: 穿实验服走进食堂的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person in a lab coat entering a cafeteria, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别穿实验服去食堂、宿舍。

shots.scene: 普通口罩图标挡不住蒸汽线，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a simple paper face mask with vapor lines passing through it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通口罩，挡不住化学蒸气。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作挥发性试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with a reagent bottle inside a chemical fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 有挥发性试剂，首先放进通风柜里操作。

shots.scene: 欣欣穿戴整齐，身旁出现盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, fully dressed in lab coat, goggles and gloves, stands beside a shield icon.
shots.narration: 穿对、戴好，能大大降低伤害。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向墙上的洗眼器和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 但光靠防护还不够，下一课讲安全设备。

shots.scene: 长裤、包脚鞋、束发、无首饰四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: long pants, closed-toe shoes, tied-back hair and bare hands without jewelry. No people.
shots.narration: 长裤包脚鞋，束发摘首饰。

shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套、围裙图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a buttoned lab coat, splash goggles, gloves and an apron. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服扣好，眼镜手套按风险选。

shots.scene: 隐形眼镜打叉，面屏和呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a contact lens crossed out, a face shield and a respirator with a training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 不戴隐形眼镜，呼吸器先培训。

shots.scene: 洗手和门把手打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of hands washing under a tap and a gloved hand on a door handle crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 离开前脱防护、洗手，手套不出门。

shots.scene: 欣欣穿戴整齐，在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, wearing a lab coat and goggles, waves goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 穿对戴好，安全实验，下次见！
